question: The paintings in the Bagh caves belong to which of the following periods?
solution:
The correct answer is **Gupta period**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Bagh Caves are a group of nine rock-cut monuments situated in the Dhar district of Madhya Pradesh, India.
 
• The paintings in these caves are renowned for their artistic excellence and belong to the Gupta period.
 
• This period, which lasted from around 320 to 550 CE, is often referred to as the Golden Age of India.
